name: Fight Colorectal Cancer
mission: We fight to cure colorectal cancer and serve as relentless champions of hope for all affected by this disease through informed patient support, impactful policy change, and breakthrough research endeavors.
theoryOfChange: Fight Colorectal Cancer has a published strategic framework called the "Colorectal Cancer Care Initiative (CRCCI)". This initiative is a national collaboration aimed at revolutionizing colorectal cancer screening, diagnosis, and treatment. It includes the "Colorectal Cancer Care Report," which is a data-driven roadmap that leveraged real-world data, scientific literature, and patient experience to establish clear, actionable goals for improving prevention, diagnosis, and care nationwide. The CRCCI outlines two key goals with specific targets: Goal 1 focuses on timely colorectal cancer screening, aiming for an 80% screening rate for average-risk patients and ensuring 80% of patients with an abnormal non-invasive screening test receive a follow-up colonoscopy within 90 days. Goal 2 addresses accurate, informative diagnosis and timely treatment initiation, with targets for treatment initiation within 6 weeks of diagnosis, biomarker testing for stage 3 or 4 CRC, and genetic testing for CRC patients.
